raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

pr-test-npu-finish aggregated the test jobs but not pr-gate, so a run blocked at the gate (missing run-ci label, draft PR, rate limit) skipped every test job and still reported all-green. Add pr-gate to its needs, matching pr-test-finish, pr-test-musa-finish and pr-test-mlx-finish. A skipped gate (coverage mode or no relevant changes) still passes, since the finish job only fails on failure/cancelled.

Also remove the pull_request self-trigger from nightly-test-npu.yml: touching that file launched the entire nightly suite on ungated NPU runners, and no other nightly workflow has such a trigger. schedule, workflow_dispatch and workflow_call callers are unaffected.

## Test plan

- YAML parses for both workflows (pr-test-npu-finish needs = [pr-gate, check-changes, ...]; nightly triggers = [schedule, workflow_dispatch, workflow_call]).
- NPU CI will validate the finish behavior on this PR once run-ci is added.

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---
### CI States

Latest PR Test (Base): <!-- slot:pr-test:start -->:white_check_mark: [Run #41379998047](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41379998047)<!-- slot:pr-test:end -->
Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #41379998067](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41379998067)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:heavy_minus_sign: **No AMD PR run found for this commit**.<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->

> [!TIP]
> Base CI only covers the core cases, and its workload may not exercise your change. Use `/rerun-test` to run the tests your change touches, or copy this prompt for an agent:
>
> ```text
> Find the registered tests this PR affects and run them with /rerun-test, following https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.agents/skills/rerun-test/SKILL.md
> ```
<!-- pr-states:end -->

> PR title must use "[Type] scope: title" or "[Type] [Hardware] scope: title". Type must be one of: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, Chore. Scope is required and may be any module or model name, with unrestricted letter case (letters, numbers, dots, underscores, slashes, or hyphens). Hardware is optional; use a single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend. Reverts must use GitHub's default format: Revert "original title". Use one space between fields and after the colon, with a non-empty title and no leading or trailing whitespace. Examples: "[Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing", "[Feat] qwen3: Add model support", "[Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance".
Edit the title; the check reruns on its own.
